description: This bar chart visually categorizes five distinct patterns of parameter-efficient fine-tuning design spaces, each represented by a horizontal bar plot with five bars of varying heights. The horizontal axis displays the category labels: “Uniform,” “Decreasing,” “Spindle,” and “Bottleneck,” with the first category partially obscured by a gray bar beneath it. The vertical axis represents the value of the design space metric, scaled linearly with no explicit label or units shown, and the bars are arranged without sorting. Each bar group shows the relative magnitude of the metric for each of the five design space configurations within that pattern. For the “Uniform” pattern, all five bars are of equal height, indicating a constant value across configurations. In the “Decreasing” pattern, the bars decrease in height from left to right, with the first bar being the tallest and the fifth the shortest. The “Spindle” pattern shows two tall bars in the middle, with shorter bars on either side, resembling a spindle shape. The “Bottleneck” pattern features two tall bars at the ends and two shorter bars in the middle, forming a bottleneck shape. The bars are all rendered in a light green color and lack any additional visual emphasis such as shading or outlines.
